name: Chair Sit-to-Stand

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: CDC STEADI Fall Prevention & NIH Senior Health

steps: Sit on the front half of a sturdy, armless chair with your feet flat on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them extended straight in front of you for counter-balance.
Lean slightly forward from your hips, keeping your chest proud and spine long.
Push firmly down through your heels to rise smoothly to a full, balanced standing position.
Hinge your hips back and bend your knees to lower yourself gently back onto the chair under control without plopping down.
coaching_cues: Do not rock back and forth to gain momentum; stand using leg strength alone.
Make sure your knees stay aligned over your second toes and do not cave inward.
Keep your eyes focused forward on the horizon.

sources.attribution: CDC STEADI Clinical Fall Prevention Standard
